2. Ohio Statehouse At Dusk Columbus // COLUMBUS, Ohio — The Ohio Statehouse, also known as the Ohio State Capitol Building, stands illuminated at dusk in Capitol Square. The Greek Revival structure, built between 1839 and 1861, serves as the seat of the Ohio state legislature. The west facade of the historic building features classical columns and a distinctive conical turret instead of the traditional dome found on many other state capitols Stock Photo - Alamy
